constraints.statement: for every (transaction_id, currency): SUM(amount_minor) = 0 and COUNT(*) >= 2 when any entry exists

COUNT(entries) = transactions.entry_count at COMMIT; entry_count is written once at posting; raises when the transactions row is not visible to the invoking role or fewer than entry_count entries are visible
a REVERSAL's entries are the exact negation of its target's entries (same account multiset, negated amounts) and its occurred_at, value_date (IS NOT DISTINCT FROM) and entry_count equal its target's
a REVERSAL's target has kind <> 'REVERSAL' and entry_count >= 2 (posted); a REVERSAL is never a reversal target
a REPOST's replaces target has kind <> 'REVERSAL' and a REVERSAL at COMMIT; the REPOST carries a value_date whenever the target has one
for a REPOST with replaces = X, every REPOST with replaces = X and a different correction_id is REVERSED at COMMIT

(transactions.status = 'reversed') = EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions r WHERE r.reverses = transactions.id) at COMMIT, evaluated for every transactions row inserted or updated and for the reverses target of every REVERSAL inserted (NEW.reverses when NEW.kind = 'REVERSAL')
(reverses, owner_id, currency) references transactions (id, owner_id, currency) [UNIQUE (id, owner_id, currency) on transactions]; (replaces, owner_id) references transactions (id, owner_id)

(transactions.exchange_group_id, owner_id) references exchange_groups (id, owner_id); (exchange_groups.reverses_group_id, owner_id) references exchange_groups (id, owner_id) [UNIQUE (id, owner_id) on exchange_groups]

BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF booked_at on transactions and BEFORE INSERT on statement_snapshots and exchange_groups: a non-NULL booked_at satisfies abs(booked_at - clock_timestamp()) <= PT5M; validates, never assigns (ADR-015 §3.1)

exactly two legs, currencies = {base, quote}, one positive base clearing entry and one negative quote clearing entry (signs inverted in a reversal group), at least one non-system account entry per leg, same owner and occurred_at

a reversal group reverses both legs; a leg of a group is reversed only inside a reversal group; the target of reverses_group_id has reverses_group_id IS NULL (a reversal group is never itself reversed); the reversal group copies base_currency, quote_currency, quoted_rate_e10, rate_source, rate_feed, rate_instant, rounding_side and occurred_at
an entry on an FX_CLEARING account belongs to an EXCHANGE_LEG or its REVERSAL

trigger_visibility_precondition: every role permitted to INSERT into transactions or entries is admitted to SELECT every row of the same transaction (ADR-018 §4.2 owner_rows is FOR ALL); a later write policy must be FOR ALL or paired with a SELECT policy of at least the same scope; triggers fail closed when rows are not visible

rejection_reasons.binding: T-CON-12 validation_rejected reasons; the API returns them without any amount
rejection_reasons.transaction_not_found: a reversal or re-post target the principal does not own, or in another currency, receives exactly the not-found answer

transactions_write_once_columns.entry_count: 0 at candidate creation; set once when status moves to posted; never changed afterwards
transactions_write_once_columns.booked_at: NULL at candidate creation; set once, with entry_count, when status moves to posted; written at INSERT for every non-candidate kind; never changed afterwards

append_only.mutable_metadata: ADR-018 §4.1, extended by this record with the one-time posting write of entry_count and booked_at; status is constrained by status_reversed_equivalence

extends_adr_018.section_1_2: adds ledger_currencies (reference), statement_snapshots and exchange_groups (constrained; evidence_ref opaque) and the new transactions/accounts columns to the inventory
extends_adr_018.section_4_1: adds the one-time trigger-guarded posting write of transactions.entry_count and transactions.booked_at to the column-level UPDATE list (ADR-018 lists .booked_at as never updatable; the exception is exactly the NULL-to-value write at posting)
extends_adr_018.section_4_2_exemption: adds ledger_currencies to the merchants/trial_fingerprints exception sentence (no row-level security; SELECT grant only)
extends_adr_018.section_4_2_lint: adds DISABLE TRIGGER, session_replication_role and GRANT SET ON PARAMETER session_replication_role to the migration lint tokens

required_for.ADMINISTRATIVE: the pending ledger request record ADR-020 §5 item 7 creates and its audit event references

correction_id.rule: one server-generated value per correction operation, shared by every row that operation posts; a re-correction of the same target uses a new value and must reverse the earlier re-posts in the same database transaction (repost_supersedes_prior)

effective_status.rule: REVERSED iff a transaction with reverses = id exists; a REVERSAL is terminal (never a reversal target) and therefore always ACTIVE; transactions.status = 'reversed' is a projection of the same rule, never returned to posted, guarded by status_reversed_equivalence

ledger_currencies.widening: additive INSERT under the E30 flag
ledger_currencies.rls: exempt from ENABLE/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY exactly like ADR-018 §4.2 merchants (global reference table, no user data); GRANT SELECT to pennilogic_app and nothing else to any runtime role; rows written by migrations as table owner; no USING (true) policy (ADR-018 §4.2/§4.4 reserve that shape for resolver_read)

derivation.effective_date: value_date if present, else the local calendar date of occurred_at in the profile time zone (ADR-015 §3.3)
derivation.balance: SUM(amount_minor) over every entry of the account, with no status predicate: entries exist only on posted transactions, and a reversed transaction's entries remain in every sum, cancelled by its reversal's
derivation.balance_asof: SUM over entries whose transaction effective_date <= D (a REVERSAL carries its target's occurred_at and value_date, so every as-of figure is restored)
derivation.balance_recorded: SUM over entries whose transaction booked_at <= r; booked_at is the posting instant (NULL until a candidate posts), so no entry appears for an r before it existed
derivation.read_models: non-authoritative; recomputed from entries; reconciled on schedule; never synced; never a write input

rate.direction: quote major units per one base major unit
rate.wire: canonical decimal string with exactly 10 fraction digits, positive-only pattern published by T-CON-05 as QuotedRate

rounding_side_values.QUOTE: provider fixed the base amount and computed the quote amount
rounding_side_values.BASE: provider fixed the quote amount and computed the base amount (fixed-destination exchange)

fees.placement: inside the leg when deducted from the exchanged amount, otherwise its own STANDARD transaction

identity.arithmetic: arbitrary-precision integer (BigInteger or NUMERIC), never BIGINT
identity.unit: one minor unit of the rounded side (exact: the discrepancy between any provider rounding mode or truncation and HALF_EVEN of the same rational)

reversal.reversal_of_reversal_group: impossible; reinstatement is a new group

converted_breakdown_component.name: ConvertedBreakdown
converted_breakdown_component.invariant: total = sum of buckets[i].amount in bucket order
converted_breakdown_component.scalar_total_allowed: only here, next to its buckets

totals.conversion_rounding: HALF_EVEN per bucket, then sum in bucket order
totals.historical_quote_rule: latest reference quote at or before the transaction's effective instant from the named feed
totals.valuation_quote_rule: latest reference quote at or before the as-of instant, labelled with its instant
